description: What is in the local archive made by archive_workouts (~/.suunto-mcp/archive/), from the folder alone: archived count, bytes, oldest/newest, problems (damaged or foreign record, missing FIT, size mismatch: never repaired or deleted), incomplete (a FIT without a record from an interrupted run; the next archive_workouts completes it), otherFiles. Local only: no Suunto call, writes nothing. It cannot say how many workouts are still missing (archive_workouts reports `remaining`).
name: get_archive_status
title: Get the local workout archive status
